morphology.pattern_note: 原词无词缀，首音节 e 读 /ə/；派生词 mengeratkan 中，meN- 在元音前实现为 meng-。

senses.zh_definition: 紧实的；牢固的；抓握或捆绑得紧而不松脱的。
senses.en_definition: Tight, firm, or secure; not loose, especially of a grip or fastening.
senses.nuances: 常描述抓握、拥抱和绳结。放在动词后可表示动作方式，如 menggenggam erat，意为紧紧握住。衣服过紧通常用 ketat；容器密封或门窗关严通常用 rapat，不能一律换成 erat。释义依据 [DBP PRPM：erat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=erat)。

senses.zh_definition: 关系密切、亲密的；也指承诺或精神联系牢固、坚定的。
senses.en_definition: Close or strong, especially of relationships; firm or steadfast, as of a commitment.
senses.nuances: 适用于友谊、亲情、合作关系及比喻性的联系。hubungan erat 可以是机构或国家之间的密切关系，并不暗示恋爱关系。强调关系牢固时可用 erat；强调空间距离近则通常用 dekat。释义依据 [DBP PRPM：erat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=erat)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Hubungan erat antara pihak sekolah dengan ibu bapa membantu meningkatkan kebajikan murid.
dual_scenarios.zh: 学校与家长之间的密切关系有助于改善学生福祉。
dual_scenarios.en: Close ties between the school and parents help improve student well-being.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 家人讨论孩子乘车
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dia pegang tangan aku erat sangat tadi sebab takut naik bas.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dia memegang tangan saya dengan sangat erat tadi kerana takut menaiki bas.
dual_scenarios.zh: 他刚才怕上巴士，把我的手握得特别紧。
dual_scenarios.en: He held my hand really tightly earlier because he was scared to get on the bus.
spoken_features: pegang 在口语中代替 memegang
aku 用于熟人之间，对应此处标准句的 saya
sebab 引出口语中的原因，对应标准句的 kerana

messages.speaker: Farah (姐姐)
messages.ms_spoken: Adik dah naik bas? Tadi dia pegang tangan aku erat sangat.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah adik sudah menaiki bas? Tadi dia memegang tangan saya dengan sangat erat.
messages.zh: 弟弟上巴士了吗？刚才他把我的手握得特别紧。
messages.en: Has our little brother got on the bus? He was holding my hand really tightly earlier.

messages.speaker: Amir (哥哥)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia duduk kat depan je. Aku teman dia sampai bas gerak.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah menaiki bas dan duduk di bahagian hadapan. Saya menemaninya sehingga bas bertolak.
messages.zh: 上了，就坐在前面。我陪他一直等到巴士开走。
messages.en: Yes, he's sitting near the front. I stayed with him until the bus left.

etymology.historical_story: Malay erat connects physical firmness with social closeness: a hand can hold tightly, and a friendship can remain strong. This semantic connection is documented in the dictionary rather than reconstructed as an origin story. Its derivatives let speakers describe strengthening both tangible fastenings and the less visible bonds between people. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=erat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /ə-rat/ 想成两拍握手声：第一拍握住，第二拍握紧；手握得紧，关系也能很 erat。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: erat 属中性标准词，适合日常交流及正式报道；hubungan erat 常用于表达友好合作。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 描述关系密切通常得体。memeluk erat 只是语言表达，实际拥抱仍须尊重对方意愿、宗教习惯及个人界限，不能据此假定双方适合身体接触。
